items.en: The copy button for MCP connection settings now works on a self-hosted instance opened over http.
items.zh: 通过 http 打开自托管实例时，MCP 连接配置的复制按钮也能使用。

items.en: A self-hosted instance opened over plain http from another device on the network now loads, and copy buttons and duplicate-upload detection work there too.
items.zh: 从局域网其他设备用 http 打开自托管实例时可以正常加载，复制按钮和重复上传检测也能使用。
